description: Assess multi-framework readiness for a named audit window, certification milestone, or new-framework launch against supplied scope, evidence, owner capacity, auditor independence, and milestone dates. Use for point-in-time readiness, not standing program design.

provenance.author: LiNKskills adaptation
provenance.source: Active task method: Borghei multi-framework common-control/evidence strategy and named-milestone sequencing. The Alireza six-question source and exact originals are retained as archived_support and route to compliance-program-decision-review.
provenance.license: See exact per-source notices in SOURCE-MANIFEST.json. Intended internal company-agent-catalog use only for Commons Clause components; no sale or substantially source-derived paid service without separate clearance.

routing.when_to_use: Assess multi-framework readiness for a named audit window, certification milestone, or new-framework launch against supplied scope, evidence, owner capacity, auditor independence, and milestone dates. Use for point-in-time readiness, not standing program design.
when_not_to_use: The request is the six-question decision packet for framework commitment, cross-framework evidence consolidation, audit-calendar approval, mock-audit results, management review or certification-stage-1 sign-off; use compliance-program-decision-review.
The request is standing framework portfolio, control/evidence architecture, annual calendar or ongoing program-backlog design; use compliance-framework-compliance-os.
A dedicated framework-specific audit pack owns the requested output.
The task requires certification, a final legal decision, official action or unsupported current-law conclusion.
exclusion_rules: Source applicability is conditional; verify current law/standard and company facts
No unapproved external effects or official record mutations
ambiguity_rules: Read authorized supplied evidence first; ask only for material facts; complete separable work

required_inputs.name: task_request
required_inputs.description: Exact named readiness milestone and requested draft.

required_inputs.name: source_documents
required_inputs.description: Authorized source documents and records for the milestone.

required_inputs.name: applicability_context
required_inputs.description: Jurisdiction, actor role, scope/version and as-of date; unknown if not established.

required_inputs.name: review_owner
required_inputs.description: Reviewer/decision-owner role and available review capacity.

required_inputs.name: frameworks_in_scope
required_inputs.description: Frameworks pursued for this named milestone and their asserted basis.

required_inputs.name: readiness_stage
required_inputs.description: New framework launch, named audit/certification milestone, or named-window renewal.

required_inputs.name: control_and_evidence_inventory
required_inputs.description: Control catalog, artifacts, owners, dates and known gaps for the milestone.

required_inputs.name: audit_calendar
required_inputs.description: Relevant planned audit periods, auditor roles and capacity for the named window.

expected_outputs.name: framework_scope_decisions
expected_outputs.description: Task-specific draft field: framework scope decisions

expected_outputs.name: shared_control_candidates
expected_outputs.description: Task-specific draft field: shared control candidates

expected_outputs.name: evidence_reuse_and_gaps
expected_outputs.description: Task-specific draft field: evidence reuse and gaps

expected_outputs.name: audit_calendar_risks
expected_outputs.description: Task-specific draft field: audit calendar risks

forbidden_actions: No legal advice, final legal determination, certification, audit opinion, regulatory filing, signature, external communication or binding company decision.
No invented law, facts, company policy, thresholds, dates, approvals, jurisdiction or evidence.
No external effect, system mutation, notification, submission, publication, record closure, production or deletion.
No source scripts, shell commands, APIs or connector aliases are callable task tools.
No unnecessary sensitive, personal, confidential or privileged content in task state or output.
verification_steps: Trace material claims to authorized evidence and pinpoint.
Verify jurisdiction/current primary authority or label as unknown.
Validate typed output and keep external effects/mutations empty.
Use only current native tools visible in the runtime; no scripts or invented APIs.
completion_criteria: Task-specific draft matches contract and acceptance conditions.
Evidence, uncertainty, applicability and owner decisions are visible.
No unapproved external effects, system changes or unsupported legal claims.
A completed_draft populates the non-empty task-specific fields in references/task-contract-shape-fixture.json and cites evidence.
A needs_context response records missing_inputs, unknown_facts and any separable partial_work without fabricating completion.
known_limitations: Structural validation is not semantic, legal, audit or runtime certification.
Pack remains draft, uncertified, unadmitted and unpublished.

telemetry.retention_policy: retain opaque task/source ids and hashes only
